title: Standing-Order Member Rates for Household Draws at Mobile In-Home Collection Visits
content:
**Member rate table — Specimen Collection Appointments, Mobile In-Home Collection Visit.**

Each additional household member drawn at a home visit is charged at a member rate that depends on the order the visit collects, as that order's records in Laboratory Test Orders show it: whether it is a standing order, and how many test charges were posted on it in the last six months.

| The order the visit collects | Test charges posted on it in the last six months | Member rate (USD per member) |
|---|---|---|
| Standing order | Six or more | 25.00 (series member rate) |
| Standing order | Three to five | 30.00 |
| Standing order | Fewer than three | 35.00 (the additional-patient fee) |
| Not a standing order | Any number | 35.00 (the additional-patient fee) |

**Clause.** When the order the visit collects is a standing order and six or more test charges were posted on it in the last six months, each member is charged at the series member rate of 25.00; when it is a standing order and three to five test charges were posted on it in that window, each member is charged at 30.00; otherwise each member is charged at the additional-patient fee of 35.00. The published additional-patient fee is 35.00 for the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit and 0.00 for every other visit type.

### Edge readings (hypothetical orders)

- Standing order, exactly six test charges in the last six months: 25.00 per member.
- Standing order, exactly three: 30.00 per member; exactly five: 30.00 per member.
- Standing order, two: 35.00 per member.
- A one-time order with nine test charges: 35.00 per member, because it is not a standing order.
